text:
jordan: Quick sync — need final call on convo endpoint shape. Customers want both 'messages' (role/structured) and a simple 'prompt' shortcut. Can we ship a clean contract by EOD Fri?

priya: engineering preference: canonical model is messages[] with roles. prompt shortcut okay if mapping is deterministic. main risk: ambiguity in role mapping and mixing system messages.

ethan: product constraints: must support tool-calling later. role clarity is critical. Launch criteria: (1) clear migration path for current completions users; (2) SDKs auto-map; (3) docs + examples; (4) one large customer sign-off.

lena: devex: SDKs can accept both but will normalize to messages[]. We'll provide code samples and linter warnings. Need spec for role precedence.

marco: ML: system vs assistant context — system should be first-policy; assistant messages with tool outputs should be taggable. Also ask about stop token behavior and incremental streaming semantics.

priya: engineering notes: mapping rules proposal: if prompt provided, wrap as user role message at end unless explicit system included. Also reserve special 'system' param: if both system and messages provided, system injects at start. Edgecases: empty prompt + messages -> ok. prompt + messages with user present -> append prompt as user-last? need decision.

jordan: customer asks: "we send templates as prompt and message history separately" — must not duplicate. Proposal: if both provided, treat prompt as 'system' only when flagged 'as_system:true' otherwise error.

ethan: Launch ops: must support rollouts: canary traffic to 10% for 48h. Telemetry: token delta, role-mapped mismatch rate, failed-parsing rate.

priya: Implementation plan: v1 schema: messages[] required. v1-compat alias: accept prompt param for 6 months; respond with deprecation header. Rollout timeline: dev preview 2 weeks, GA 8 weeks.

lena: docs checklist: migration guide, SDK samples (py/ts/go), playground demos, migration linter.

marco: Tests: model behavior tests to ensure system injection precedence across top-5 models. Provide eval prompts to catch role-sensitivity regressions.

jordan: Decision: messages-first API. prompt alias allowed only when 'prompt_mode' is 'compat' and server returns warning header. Action items: priya implement server mapping (owner: priya, eta: 2w), lena write SDK normalization (owner: lena, eta: 10d), marco create evals (owner: marco, eta: 1w), ethan customer comms (owner: ethan, eta: 3d).

deploy-bot: deploy queued: convo-schema-compat-check (CI) started.

jordan: TL;DR: messages[] canonical, prompt alias tolerated with strict rules; must ship with SDK mappings, telemetry and a deprecation plan. :thumbsup:
